test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following teams won the IPL 2023 championship?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai Super Kings.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Chennai Super Kings (CSK) defeated the Gujarat Titans (GT) by 5 wickets in a thrilling last-ball finish.
 
• The CSK team was led by their iconic** captain,** **MS Dhoni.**
 
• **Devon Conway **was awarded the **"Player of the Match"** for his brilliant 47 off 25 balls in the final.
 
• This victory marked** CSK's 5th IPL title**, putting them **on par with the Mumbai Indians (MI)** for the most IPL titles won by a franchise.
 
• Their previous wins were in 2010, 2011, 2018, and 2021.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The Gujarat Titans led by **Hardik Pandya**, finished as the **runners-up in the 2023 IPL** season.
 
• In the 2023 IPL season, Lucknow Super Giants led by **KL Rahul**, finished **3rd** in the league stage.
 
• **Mumbai Indians (MI)** is the **most successful** franchise in IPL history, having won the **IPL title five times**—in 2013, 2015, 2017, 2019, and 2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
